move: keyboard tilts up, keys pop from centre, callouts fly in, backlight waves
how: A CSS keyboard (60 keys in a 15-column grid, one black Touch ID key) tweens from rotateX 60 / y 200 / scale 0.8 to rotateX 18 with expo.out over 1.2s while every key scales from 0 with back.out(2) in a grid stagger from the centre (each 0.012). Six spec callouts fade/rise in at 0.15s offsets (expo.out) with their leader lines scaling from 0. At 40% a backlight wave rolls across the keys left-to-right (backgroundColor to white with a glow box-shadow, yoyo, grid stagger on the x axis each 0.02) and at 60% right-to-left; the Touch ID key pulses its glow yoyo ×3. The board drifts rotateY -4→4 sine.inOut the whole duration. Exit at 82%: specs fade up, board tilts away to rotateX 70 / y 300 with expo.in, title exits.
adapt: Change the six spec labels and their anchor positions, the key layout rows, and the board colours; keep the grid stagger from centre, the 0.15s callout cadence and the two backlight waves.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the key grid from the rows array and the callouts; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with tilt at 0-0.3D, callouts 0.25-0.55D, waves at 0.4D and 0.6D, exit from 0.82D. from() on keys needs immediateRender:false; the grid stagger needs gsap.utils.toArray scoped to el.
caveats: boxShadow and backgroundColor tweens on 60 keys with grid stagger, moderately heavy
the last key row has fewer cells so the grid:[4,15] stagger is approximate
